title: Parse hospital CSV MRF formats
objective: Supported hospital wide/tall CSV files share the JSON metadata contract.
outcome: Pin CMS hospital-price-transparency wide and tall CSV v3.0.0 official fictional examples. A generic CSV header parser cannot misclassify a metadata row as the variable schema. Wide and tall synthetic representations yield equivalent selected charges without losing payer/plan associations. Format equivalence applies to the fixture values only; it does not prove two real hospital files describe identical periods/services. Partial or malformed rows remain visible and cannot fabricate zero prices. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Pin wide and tall CSV layouts
commits.instructions: Capture official CMS template/version definitions and representative header rows. Distinguish facility metadata rows from item rows and repeated payer columns.
commits.verification: A generic CSV header parser cannot misclassify a metadata row as the variable schema.

commits.subject: Implement CSV layout adapters
commits.instructions: Parse quoted/multiline fields, nulls and payer-specific columns with bounded rows/bytes. Preserve source column names and exact row locations.
commits.verification: Wide and tall synthetic representations yield equivalent selected charges without losing payer/plan associations.

commits.subject: Verify cross-format equivalence
commits.instructions: Compare JSON, wide CSV and tall CSV official examples through the same output contract and retain unsupported-layout failures.
commits.verification: Format equivalence applies to the fixture values only; it does not prove two real hospital files describe identical periods/services.
